problem.title: Merge Intervals
problem.statement: Given a list of intervals (start-end time pairs). Merge all overlapping intervals. For example [1,3] and [2,6] overlap to become [1,6].
problem.hint: If intervals are sorted by start time, you only need to compare one by one from left to right. When do two intervals definitely overlap?
problem.walkthrough:
Example intervals: [[1,3], [2,6], [8,10], [9,12], [15,18]].

Sort (already sorted): [1,3], [2,6], [8,10], [9,12], [15,18]

Take [1,3] as start.
[2,6]: start 2 <= end 3? Yes! Overlap. Merge: [1, max(3,6)] = [1,6].
[8,10]: start 8 <= end 6? No. New interval: [8,10].
[9,12]: start 9 <= end 10? Yes! Merge: [8, max(10,12)] = [8,12].
[15,18]: start 15 <= end 12? No. New interval: [15,18].

Answer: [[1,6], [8,12], [15,18]]

Key insight: sort by start first, then check one by one: still overlapping? Merge. Separated? Start a new interval.
